messages:
Elena: quick flag — found a dead internal link in handbook/ops/deploy-checklist.md under the 'post-deploy smoke tests' section. the link points to /handbook/runtime/healthchecks.md#smoke but that fragment 404s. anyone hit this before?
Marco: I saw that yesterday while following the checklist. looked like the fragment changed to #smoke-tests.
Tasha: thanks for surfacing @Elena — can we decide whether to update the checklist or add an anchor redirect in healthchecks? docs-bot tends to prefer fixing the referencing page.
docs-bot: automated-scan: broken-fragment detected in handbook/ops/deploy-checklist.md -> handbook/runtime/healthchecks.md#smoke (rule=internal-fragment). recommended action: update link to #smoke-tests or add `<!-- anchor: smoke -->` to target page.
Elena: happy to open a tiny PR. plan: 1) add frontmatter owner: @Elena to deploy-checklist.md, 2) update the fragment to #smoke-tests, 3) add a short changelog entry. will keep it single commit.
Marco: SGTM. small sed to add owner frontmatter if useful: ```bash
sed -i "1s/^/owner: @Elena\n/" handbook/ops/deploy-checklist.md
```
Tasha: if you're touching healthchecks, please also add an HTML anchor comment for evals: `<!-- eval-anchor: smoke-tests -->` so our autosmoke references don't break.
Elena: good call. i'll update both pages in one PR: replace fragment on deploy-checklist, add `<!-- anchor: smoke -->` in healthchecks as a redirect comment plus the canonical `<!-- eval-anchor: smoke-tests -->`. also compress one large gif in the checklist images folder to avoid staging 503 flakiness.
Marco: ping me for review, i'll check the relative links. quick reminder: prefer absolute /handbook paths in cross-doc links.
Elena: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/13021 — title: "fix deploy checklist broken fragment + owner" — @Marco @Tasha please review.
Tasha: reviewing now. left 2 tiny nits (one about heading casing, one about image alt text). marking ready for Marco to sanity-check links.
Marco: LGTM after nits addressed. request small follow-up commit.
Elena: pushed fixes. CI green. merge on green.
deploy-bot: deploy: docs site rebuild queued due to docs PR merge (#13021).
docs-bot: automated-scan: broken-fragment resolved, owner set (owner=@Elena), anchor redirect added.
Elena: merged and left a short note in #eng-announce: "Ops: deploy-checklist updated (owner=@Elena), fixed smoke-test link." thanks for the quick help. :rocket:
Tasha: nice and quick. if anyone sees more of these, drop the page path and the failing fragment here and we'll triage in the morning.
